name: 共同編集者一覧の選択・種別検索帯
prompt:
Recreate only the GitHub collaborator-management control strip in the primary source crop. Match its 1024:140 aspect ratio (about 7.31:1), broad horizontal layout, pale neutral toolbar, thin bottom divider and white search field with a light border. No Japanese mock exists for this added source.

Top row: at the far left, an empty square checkbox followed by the label 「すべて選択」. At the far right, show the compact 「種類」 dropdown label and a small downward caret. Keep the checkbox unchecked and preserve the wide empty space between the left and right controls.

Second row: one nearly full-width rounded search field inset from both edges, with a small magnifying-glass icon at the left and the placeholder 「共同編集者を検索...」 in muted gray. Match the source field height, border, corner radius and inset.

Keep the original two-row height and alignment, light gray toolbar surface, subtle separators and restrained typography. Do not add buttons, people, results, invitation rows, page context or additional controls.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 preserves the unchecked Select all control, Type dropdown and collaborator search field. Dimensions are 2172x724 (3.0:1) against source 1024x140 (7.3143:1); SHA-256 8213c6a01fa55b7d921cd75ff3ffc9a5d8fd7083e6f9a4d6700eada581f36b8e. The control strip is centered inside large blank bands, so its full canvas does not match the source aspect. Status: needs-correction; one tight-framing revision remains.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
